name: Meshach
summary: Meshach, first called Mishael, was one of Daniel's friends from Judah taken to Babylon. With Shadrach and Abednego he would not worship the king's golden image and was thrown into a fiery furnace, but God delivered them.

key_moments.title: Tested for Ten Days
key_moments.description: Daniel asked that he, Mishael and their friends be given vegetables and water instead of the king's food. After ten days they looked healthier than all the others, and God gave the four of them knowledge and wisdom.

key_moments.title: Praying for a Secret
key_moments.description: When the king's wise men faced death, Daniel told Mishael and his other friends to ask the God of heaven for mercy about the king's secret. That night the secret was shown to Daniel.

key_moments.title: Thrown into the Fiery Furnace
key_moments.description: Meshach and his friends would not serve the king's gods or bow to the golden image. They were bound and thrown into a furnace heated seven times hotter, and the king saw four men walking free in the fire.

key_moments.title: Comes Out of the Fire Unharmed
key_moments.description: Nebuchadnezzar called them out, and the fire had not singed a hair of their heads. He blessed their God, who had sent His angel to deliver them, and promoted them in the province of Babylon.
